demo.title: check.sh
demo.code:
# Read-only pause check on Base Mainnet (no key, no payment)
node scripts/check.mjs 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913

# Tokenized stock (Coinbase B20 AAPL) before a sell
node scripts/check.mjs --token 0xb200000000000000000000C2e324d24d7eEcd1fb --side sell

# Offline fixtures
node scripts/selftest.mjs

setup: Requires Node 18+ (built-in fetch). No API key, wallet, npm package, or payment.
Before a buy, sell, or LP of a token on Base, run: `node scripts/check.mjs <token>`
Fail closed if verdict is EXIT_BLOCKED. Warn and ask the user if UNKNOWN or NOT_CONTRACT. PAUSE_CLEAR means only that the contract is not paused — it is not a liquidity or issuer check.
